title: Source registry
description: Every number in this dataset points at an entry here. No entry, no number.

tier.description: breeder = the people who bred or license it (highest trust). lab = published GC/HPLC analysis. merchant = supplier spec sheet. literature = book or peer-reviewed paper. aggregator = a site that itself compiled from elsewhere. unsourced = placeholder, must not appear in a published record.

weight.description: Relative trust used when rolling observations into a published range.
